name: Kuon no Kanata
source:
A thousand years had passed since the hero defeated the demon lord and humanity claimed dominion over the continent.
In a society where magic dictated all value, the aristocracy began to show its cracks.
The system, once a source of pride, was slowly warping into something unrecognizable.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/32355]freem[/url]]
translation:
距离英雄击败魔王、人类统治这片大陆已经过去了一千年。
在一个魔法决定一切价值的社会里，贵族开始显现出它的裂痕。
这个曾经令人自豪的系统正在慢慢地变得面目全非。
